name: Bi-Factorial Preference Optimization Benchmark
description: A benchmark including comprehensive discriminative and generative tasks designed to evaluate the balance of safety and helpfulness in large language models fine-tuned with the Bi-Factorial Preference Optimization framework.
reputation: A niche benchmark associated with the Bi-Factorial Preference Optimization line of work, with limited evidence of broad community adoption.
notes: Benchmark evaluates both safety and helpfulness in LLMs; uses a supervised learning framework to balance these factors; aims to reduce human labor and computational resources.
